theorems.name: Submission.coareaJacobian_eq_normDet_adjoint
theorems.statement: ∀ (N m : ℕ) (M : Set (Rn N)) (f : Rn N → Rn m) (x : Rn N), coareaJacobian M f x = (LinearMap.adjoint ((fderiv ℝ f x).comp (tangentSpace M x).subtypeL).toLinearMap).normDet
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
